title: 第九章交易第十六章丹烛观第十章火弹术
slug: 凡人修仙我能变废为宝
lines: “明天便是洛仙子炼丹之日，你早点准备，跑来我这里做什么？”
吃完晚饭，江离衡量了许久，最终还是决定找宋展。
敲响宋展房门，却见宋展略带斥责的说道。
可见，洛仙子来炼丹，也给了他不小的压力。
思索片刻，最终江离还是决定直入主题。
“师弟现在的修为已经是炼气一层，所以想着找一篇术法来修炼。思来想去，也只有宋师兄这里可能有术法，所以想来问问看。”
道明来意，宋展却罕见的皱起眉头。
坐在椅子上，手指轻轻敲打着桌子。
术法，他倒是有一篇。
虽不是什么高级术法，却也不是能轻易给别人的。
之前宋展愿意将敛气法诀借给江离，是因为那篇敛气法诀本身就是残篇。
自己研究了几年都没有研究明白，就借给江离几日，料他也研究不透。
正因如此，借了也就借了，不过是用来做个人情。
但这术法可就不一样了。
那可是一篇完整的，还是他花了很大的代价才弄到的东西。
非亲非故，岂能说借就借？
天下没有免费的午餐。
修仙界说是修仙，其实谁人也逃脱不了利益二字。
平日里说是以师兄弟，便是亲兄弟，有时候也得明算账不是？
宋展道：“江师弟啊，不是师兄小气。虽然我所会的术法只是低阶术法，但也不是平白无故就有的。仅是你红口白牙一张嘴，就让我借出去，未免也太把这术法看轻了。”
“你回去吧！今晚好好休息，明天还要伺候洛仙子炼丹，万不可耽误了。”
说完，便要赶走江离。
原因很简单。
宋展自然不愿平白无故传授给江离术法，可若是江离能用一些能打动他的东西来交换，倒是可以。
只是江离不过是一名杂役弟子，他身上能有什么？
黄庭经？
黄庭丹？
除了这些他还能有什么？
而且这两样东西他又不稀罕，自然不想与江离在这上面做过多纠缠。
江离对此早有准备，知道这术法不像敛气诀法那般好弄到，立刻说道：“若是师弟能拿出可以打动宋师兄的物件，不知师兄是否愿意交换？”

"Tomorrow is Fairy Luo's day of elixir refining. Why should you come to my place to prepare early?"
After dinner, Jiang Li weighed it for a long time and finally decided to find Song Zhan.
Knocking on the door of Song Zhan's room, he saw Song Zhan saying slightly reproachfully.
It can be seen that Fairy Luo's coming to refine the elixir also put a lot of pressure on him.
After thinking for a moment, Jiang Li finally decided to get straight to the point.
"Junior brother is now at the first level of Qi refining, so I want to find a technique to practice. After thinking about it, only Senior Brother Song may have a technique here, so I want to ask."
After explaining his intention, Song Zhan frowned in a rare way.
Sitting on the chair, tapping the table with her fingers.
He does have an article about magic.
Although it is not an advanced technique, it is not something that can be given to others easily.
Song Zhan was willing to lend the Qi Condensation Technique to Jiang Li because the Qi Condensation Technique itself was a fragment.
After studying it for several years, I couldn't figure it out, so I lent it to Jiang Li for a few days, but he didn't expect him to figure it out either.
Because of this, if you borrow it, you just borrow it, just to do a favor.
But this technique is different.
It was a complete article, and it was something he spent a lot of money to get.
If you are not a relative or an acquaintance, how can you just borrow it?
There is no free lunch in the world.
The world of cultivating immortals is called cultivating immortals, but in fact no one can escape the word profit.
On weekdays, they are considered to be brothers, but they are also brothers, but sometimes they have to settle accounts clearly, right?
Song Zhan said: "Junior brother Jiang, it's not that senior brother is stingy. Although the spells I know are only low-level spells, they don't come for no reason. Just because you have a red mouth and white teeth, and you let me borrow it, you are too underestimating this spell."
"Go back! Have a good rest tonight. Tomorrow you will have to serve Fairy Luo in refining elixirs. Don't delay."
After saying that, he wanted to drive Jiang Li away.
The reason is simple.
Song Zhan naturally didn't want to teach Jiang Li the technique for no reason, but it would be okay if Jiang Li could exchange it for something that could impress him.
It's just that Jiang Li is just a handyman disciple, what can he have on him?
Huang Tingjing?
Huang Tingdan?
What else can he have besides these?
And he didn't care about these two things, so he naturally didn't want to get too entangled with Jiang Li on them.
Jiang Li was prepared for this. He knew that this technique was not as easy to obtain as the Qi Condensation Technique, so he immediately said: "If Junior Brother can come up with something that can impress Senior Brother Song, I wonder if Senior Brother is willing to exchange it?"
"Oh?"
